caption: Screenshot from The National Geologic Map Database (U.S. Department of the Interior and the U.S. Geological Survey).
alt: A screenshot of an online geologic map of the United States: a patchwork of bright colors, each a different kind of bedrock, laid over the outlines of cities and states.
bibliography: U.S. Geological Survey. Screenshot of the National Geologic Map Database. U.S. Department of the Interior.
